stem: How are paragraphs 8 through 10 important to the development of the plot?

options.label: A
options.text: They show Kevin overcoming an emotional experience of his youth.

options.label: B
options.text: They reveal that Kevin wants something different than what the town wants.

options.label: C
options.text: They introduce the idea of Kevin leaving the community to play elsewhere.

options.label: D
options.text: They explain how Kevin’s abilities may help the entire community.
